Title: LinkedIn Learning and LCvista Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Text:
Authentication: SSO
Content Discovery: Automated and Manual Catalog Sync options.
Reporting: xAPI
Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and LCvista integration involves the following requirements:

An active LCvista LMS instance
An active LinkedIn Learning account
Admin access to LinkedIn Learning
Admin privileges to your LCvista instance
Organization access to this feature on LCvista - please contact your LCvista account manager to enable this feature

SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.

We recommend SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. You can configure SSO authentication in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most organizations have a centrally-managed identity management solution like Azure AD, Okta, or ADFS, which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise applications like LinkedIn Learning.
To configure SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.
The LinkedIn Learning library contains over 25,000 courses, with 20-30 courses added per week at no extra cost.

LCvista automates this process using the LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, LCvista will dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of release.
All content titles and descriptions are aggregated and indexed to accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability.

LCvista supports automatic syncing of English Only content libraries. An organization will have the option to sync new content automatically or manually; in the case of manual selection the organization will be responsible for specifying the exact content to be loaded to their site.

LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses xAPI to communicate a learner's activity back to LCvista when the learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course. All LinkedIn Learning course completions will be reported both in LinkedIn Learning and in LCvista.
Important

To ensure xAPI completions flow back and update correctly in LCvista, SSO must be configured to send a matching user identifier. The Unique User ID in LinkedIn Learning must align exactly with the Username value in LCvista.
Note

For NASBA-eligible courses, certificate-based completion can be enabled so that xAPI completion statements are generated only after the learner earns the LinkedIn Learning course certificate. This ensures course completions align with NASBA CPE credit requirements. To enable certificate-based completion for NASBA-eligible courses, please contact your LinkedIn Learning representative or submit a support ticket to request this configuration.
Enabling SSO:

LinkedIn Learning recommends SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. SSO authentication can be configured in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most organizations have a centrally managed identity management solution like Azure AD, Okta or AD FS which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise applications like LinkedIn Learning.

To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

Blocks.Text: To sync your LCvista content with LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Log in to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Me > Integrate





From the side navigation menu, Access content and reports via API.





Click the down arrow on the right to expand the Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application section.

Click Add Application and provide the name related to your LMS (e.g., "LCvista LMS Integration"), as the application name, and provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field.





There are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select the fields that apply to you. For Content Sync to the LMS, only Content is required.

Click Next and agree to the Terms and Conditions

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values.

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LCvista
Blocks.Text: To complete the configuration with LCvista, you need the following information:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LCvista
Blocks.Text: • Client ID

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LCvista
Blocks.Text: • Client Secret

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LCvista
Blocks.Text: Once you’ve gathered the required information and have logged into the LCvista LMS, follow these steps below:

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LCvista
Blocks.Text:
Access LCvista, find Integration Providers. Select the External Catalog Providers tab and Add Provider.





Enter Client ID & Client Secret and then select Save.





As a result of saving the above, a new card on this page will appear, LinkedIn Learning Reporting Integration xAPI credentials.





Retrieve Client ID, Client Secret, Tenant Server URL and OAuth Server URL from LCvista under LinkedIn Learning Reporting Integration xAPI credentials (this will be used when returning to LinkedIn Learning to complete the xAPI reporting configuration).

Next Define Topic Area Handling in LCvista. Specifically choose whether you wish to use the expected duration sent by LinkedIn Learning to calculate a 50-minute credit hour across non-NASBA sponsored courses.
NASBA sponsored courses will be loaded based on the NASBA topic area and credit value specified. Non-NASBA sponsored courses will be loaded with a None field of study.





On the Content tab, select the content sync preference:

Automate Full Catalog Sync: All LinkedIn Learning content will be automatically created and loaded into LCvista.

Manual Selection: Courses are reviewed and manually selected before being loaded into LCvista. Administrators must return to the Content tab to review and load any new courses made available.







 Note
Regardless of the sync preference, any courses that have already been loaded will be automatically updated if LinkedIn Learning retires a course or releases an update.

SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LCvista
Blocks.Text: Please note that it can take up to 48 hours for LCvista to index and make content available to learners.

Blocks.Text: Using the information you acquired in LCvista, follow the instructions below to configure XAPI configuration within LinkedIn Learning

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you login, if you are not already in the Admin screen, click Go to Admin, then select Me > Integrate.





From the side navigation menu, select Configure reporting integrations.

Expand the Configure xAPI section.

Click Add integration.





In the Integration name field, enter a name such as "LCvista Reporting".

In the User Type drop down, select ID. This value must match the Username in LCvista. Please reach out to support@lcvista.com if you need assistance identifying this value.

Copy and paste the following items provided by LCvista into LinkedIn Learning:

OAuth Server URL
Tenant Server URL
Client ID
Client Secret


Select Course completions under Confirm which data you want to share for this integration.

Click Enable.
